description: This file defines the 'NationalityController' class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the admin plugin's controller namespace. The controller extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a Vue component for the nationality list view during pre-rendering.

classes.name: NationalityController
classes.description: A controller class for managing the nationality list view in the admin plugin, extending the AbstractVueController and preparing a Vue component for rendering.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Set up the Vue component 'nationality-list' before rendering the view.
